description: This is a Java test class for HibernateFormDAO, which tests data access object methods related to form filtering and retrieval within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: HibernateFormDAOTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing HibernateFormDAO functionalities related to Forms and FormFields in OpenMRS.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data before each test case by executing a predefined dataset.

methods.name: shouldFilterAgainstFormFields
methods.description: Tests the DAO's ability to filter Forms based on associated FormFields and other criteria.

methods.name: shouldGetFormFieldsByForm
methods.description: Verifies retrieving FormFields associated with a specific Form.
